skipped.reason: Feature request for async cudaHostRegister — no concrete test path referenced; the startup behavior it describes is exercised implicitly by existing simple_kv_offload unit tests.
Roadmap RFC — no concrete test or workload parameters; roadmap items are reflected in individual PRs already captured.
Experimental API (VLLM_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_SESSION_EVICTION=1) with no stable test path yet; the corresponding test file is not present in the local clone.

Pluggable eviction policy — the PR body does not reference a new test path beyond test_kv_cache_manager.py which is already in the base harness (unit-kv-cache-manager); annotated with source_ref on that entry.
TOCTOU fix in SimpleCPUOffloadScheduler — the fix is behaviorally covered by gh_simple_kv_offload_scheduler_regression (test_scheduler.py); no separate test path added.
LMCache cache miss — LMCache is an external connector; no test path within the vllm local clone; skip to avoid out-of-tree dependency.
DeepSeek V4 on R6000 GPU — hardware-specific (AMD RDNA3 GPU, not the target hardware for this validation run); skip.

DeepSeek-V4-Flash + OffloadingConnector crashes — requires DeepSeek-V4-Flash model weights which are not available in the local model cache; partially covered by gh_offloading_connector_scheduler_unit.

Skip per-tensor scale parameters from CPU offload — quantization-specific, no distinct test path beyond what is already exercised by quantization/test_cpu_offload.py (not in scope of this validation run's primary target components).
request_finished method + decouple store — internal refactor; covered by existing offloading_connector tests; no new test path needed.
Cache-affinity-aware request ordering RFC — conceptual, no concrete test or workload parameters defined yet.

notes: GitHub CLI (gh) was not available in this environment; queries were performed via the GitHub REST API (curl + GitHub Search API). All test paths were verified against the local vllm clone at commit 40651c020772b80f9ca80272aebe749fe01cd38a. Entries where path_verified=false would have been noted in the harness_map entries; all entries in this discovery pass had their paths confirmed to exist. The base artifacts/kvoffload/ files were not modified as required; all new content is written exclusively to artifacts/kvoffload_extended/.
